credentials: PHD 2024 New Jersey Inst Of Technology
name: YASSINE TISSAOUI

ratings.comment: The class was restructured and he provided very few resources to help learn the new material. Studying outside of class was hard as there was barely anything to use and tests were unpredictable.
handwriting is bad and exams are difficult but ratings are overblown he's not that bad. If you put the time in to actually learn the material you will be fine.

I think this class if you have this professor would be summed up that the grading system for tests and practice tests is so bad that we students did regrade requests and corrected some mistakes. It is safe to say that this semester that not that many are getting As or ABs and the reason is because of this professor so take anybody else.

The definition of " I want to see you fail". The content is not related to the test, or the test difficulty is cranked up way past what the textbook or his notes he give to the class. No legible writing, like idk how you make the pi symbol look like r and vice versa. Answers the question, and you come out dumber, and he won't respond to feedback.

Exam content is almost impossible to fully prepare for if you ONLY do every problem in notes/worksheets/practice exams, must do all textbook problems too. Content itself isn't extremely difficult, it's the fact he doesn't provide proper ways to prepare for the exams. Why give practice exams that aren't like our exam?

Included a whole new concept on Midterm 1 never taught to us, including a formula that wasn't on Canvas's formula sheet. Had to teach myself on the spot pooping my pants. When I asked for guidance for next exam, he told me I should've "read the book" which isn't required or even suggested. Class isn't even hard, he's just unhelpful.

His accent makes it so hard to understand and his handwriting is awful. He has to curve the class because all of his test scores are so low. His averages are well within the 70 range on exams and it is so hard to prepare for them. Overall is a nice guy but is not a great teacher.
Can't read any of the handwriting. Practice exams aren't even close to the real exams. The exams are terrible and made up of things he doesn't teach.

The class got restructured this semester and he thinks it's a good idea to put out last semester's test as review material. Not only is there no overlap, he gets also half of the answer key wrong. And the part that is not wrong is written in hieroglyphics. The class itself is not hard, he makes it hard.
Illegible handwriting.  Pitiful monotone and teaching style.  Fails to teach content that is covered on exams.
Illegible handwriting.  Teaches content that is not on exam.
This guy sucks. very condescending

The worst professor I have ever had at UW-Madison. Cannot explain or teach the material and his handwriting is impossible to read to the point lectures aren't worth attending. Not sure how he got a job.
Don't take him at all costs. Any good reviews for this man are lying. AVOID AVOID AVOID

Most condescending professor I have ever had. He tries to make you feel stupid for asking any questions. He does not understand math and does the problems wrong both in class and on reviews. I am greatly disappointed in UW-Madison for allowing this professor to teach.

Would not recommend taking Math 213 with him. The tests are impossible and require too much preparation to still end up with a bad grade, and they're worth 90% of your grade. The course was sold to me as an easy A-AB and it ended up being my hardest class with him teaching.
Worst math professor I have ever had.

Math 213 is not an insanely difficult class by any means, Yassine makes the class harder than it should be. Exams are 90% of the grade. Practice exams, quizzes and lectures do not prepare students. Additionally he is extremely condescending, which is weird because he gets questions wrong a lot.

Bad, bad, bad. If you have another option, you gotta get out. The most condescending professor I have had. When a student asked if there would be more questions on the final exam because there is more time, he responded with, 'The Final will be of appropriate length for the amount of time available,' and that pretty much sums up the whole class...

Yassine clearly thinks the material is basic knowledge and refuses to explain any concepts. His lectures are basically him working thru problems without explaining any of the steps. His handwriting is next to impossible toread.
The class has been restructured and is much more difficulty now. The professor makes the class even harder.

His handwriting is unreadable. It is easier to learn from the books than the professor. At least 3 students walk out every lecture as his teaching style makes the material more confusing. He is not easy to reach and will not answer questions. Lecture and review for midterms don't cover what is on the exams. Avoid at all costs. Worst professor ever.
He is a solid professor. Would highly recommend this lecture.

I had Professor Tissaoui for MATH 340, and he wasn't too bad. The only bad thing about his lectures is there is a lot of content he covers within a short period of time(which is probably due to the course structure) and his handwriting isn't the best either. But he is probably one of the better lecturers for MATH 340, so I would recommend him.
this dudes handwriting is so bad its almost impossible to follow along in class.

Professor Tissaoui was able to explain things well during lecture, but his handwriting was terrible. It ended up being alright though, because he ended up posting another professor's notes with better handwriting (that was in the exact same format) for us!

Yassine was alright as a professor. I think the biggest setback is the pre-written slides he presents for lecture. There is a book to read before class, but lecture takes care of it. His handwriting is be desired at many moments. Complex ideas weren't articulated as clearly one wanted. A lot of times there was a question of "why".
